Construct the TypeScript client and access its typed service namespaces.

## `Eyeball`

Authenticated TypeScript entry point for every Eyeball SDK namespace.

### Constructor

```ts no-check
constructor(options: EyeballOptions): Eyeball
```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `options` | <code>EyeballOptions</code> | Yes | Project credential, executor URL, user binding, and optional test seams. |

**Returns:** <code>Eyeball</code>

### Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Readonly | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `connections` | <code>ConnectionsClient</code> | Yes | Yes | Development connection fixture administration. |
| `executions` | <code>ExecutionsClient</code> | Yes | Yes | Execution history and terminal-state polling. |
| `files` | <code>FilesClient</code> | Yes | Yes | Project-scoped staged file operations. |
| `subscriptions` | <code>SubscriptionsClient</code> | Yes | Yes | User-scoped trigger subscription operations. |
| `tools` | <code>ToolsClient</code> | Yes | Yes | Local discovery and canonical tool execution. |
| `triggers` | <code>TriggersClient</code> | Yes | Yes | Local canonical trigger discovery. |
| `webhooks` | <code>WebhooksClient</code> | Yes | Yes | Signed webhook endpoint and delivery operations. |

## Types

### `EyeballOptions`

Authentication, executor location, user binding, and transport seams.

```ts no-check
export interface EyeballOptions {
  apiKey: string;
  baseUrl: string;
  fetch?: typeof globalThis.fetch;
  /** Default end-user binding for user-scoped methods. */
  userId?: string;
  /** Test seam used by execution polling. */
  clock?: EyeballClock;
  /** Test seam used by execution polling. */
  sleep?: EyeballSleep;
  /** Development-only escape hatch for non-loopback cleartext executor URLs. */
  allowInsecureHttp?: boolean;
}
```

| Property | Type | Required | Readonly | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `allowInsecureHttp` | <code>boolean</code> | No | No | Development-only escape hatch for non-loopback cleartext executor URLs. |
| `apiKey` | <code>string</code> | Yes | No | — |
| `baseUrl` | <code>string</code> | Yes | No | — |
| `clock` | <code>EyeballClock</code> | No | No | Test seam used by execution polling. |
| `fetch` | <code>(input: string &#124; URL &#124; Request, init?: RequestInit) =&gt; Promise&lt;Response&gt;</code> | No | No | — |
| `sleep` | <code>EyeballSleep</code> | No | No | Test seam used by execution polling. |
| `userId` | <code>string</code> | No | No | Default end-user binding for user-scoped methods. |

### `EyeballClock`
